fact: 1917年2月23日（儒略历；公历3月8日）彼得格勒女工在国际妇女节上街，抗议面包配给与物价，普梯洛夫工厂的罢工者随即加入，示威在数日内扩大为全城罢工。至2月25日（儒略历；公历3月10日），彼得格勒几乎所有工业企业停工，罢工人数约25万。当日沙皇电令军区司令哈巴洛夫以步枪驱散人群，26日（公历3月11日）市中心被封锁。

sources.title: Wikipedia, February Revolution（俄历与公历并列叙述）
sources.quote: On 23 February O.S. (8 March N.S.), the Putilov Factory protesters were joined in the uprising by those celebrating International Women's Day and protesting against the government's food rationing. ... By 25 February O.S (10 March N.S), nearly all industrial enterprises in Petrograd were shut down by the uprising. Although all gatherings on the streets were absolutely forbidden some 250,000 people were on strike.

sources.title: 联合国，国际妇女节历史（中文）
sources.quote: 按照俄罗斯当时采用的罗马儒略历，这个具有历史意义的星期日是2月23日，而在其他地方通用的公历上是3月8日。

fact: 1917年2月27日（儒略历；公历3月12日），彼得格勒卫戍部队大部分倒向革命一方；同日国家杜马临时委员会组建临时政府，彼得格勒工兵代表苏维埃也正式成立，此后数月俄国处于「双重政权」之下：临时政府掌管各部与战争，苏维埃掌握士兵与工人的实际动员能力。

sources.title: Wikipedia, February Revolution
sources.quote: On 27 February O.S. (12 March N.S.), most of the forces of the capital's garrison sided with the revolutionaries. On the same day, the Russian Provisional Government, made up of left-leaning Duma members, was formed. ... The Petrograd Soviet and the Provisional Government shared dual power over Russia.

fact: 1917年3月2日（儒略历；公历3月15日）下午3时，尼古拉二世在滞留于普斯科夫的车厢中被迫退位，并提名其弟米哈伊尔大公继位；3月3日（儒略历；公历3月16日）米哈伊尔决定不接受皇位，罗曼诺夫王朝三百年的统治至此终结。

sources.title: Wikipedia, February Revolution
sources.quote: At 3 o'clock in the afternoon of Thursday, 2 March O.S (15 March N.S), Nicholas nominated his brother, the Grand Duke Michael Alexandrovich, to succeed him. ... The 300-year-old Romanov dynasty ended with the Grand Duke's decision on 3 March O.S (16 March N.S).

fact: 1917年4月18日（儒略历；公历5月1日）外交部长米留可夫向协约国发出照会，承诺把战争进行到「光荣的结局」；4月20日至21日（俄历；公历5月3日至4日）彼得格勒工人与士兵大规模示威反对继续战争，米留可夫与陆军部长古契科夫被迫辞职，临时政府随后与苏维埃谈判组建联合政府。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Russian Provisional Government
sources.quote: On 18 April 1 May, N.S. 1917, minister of Foreign Affairs Pavel Milyukov sent a note to the Allied governments, promising to continue the war to 'its glorious conclusion'. On 20–21 April 1917, massive demonstrations of workers and soldiers erupted against the continuation of war. The Provisional Government accepted the resignation of Foreign Minister Milyukov and War Minister Guchkov

fact: 1917年7月3日至7日（儒略历；公历7月16日至20日）彼得格勒爆发「七月事件」：第一机枪团带头武装示威，喀琅施塔得水兵约2万人入城，示威者一度达50万人，要求「全部政权归苏维埃」。临时政府调忠实部队入城驱散示威，指控布尔什维克受德国资助煽动叛乱，列宁逃往芬兰，托洛茨基、加米涅夫等人被捕；7月12日（俄历）克伦斯基在东线恢复死刑。

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Days
sources.quote: The July Days ... were a period of unrest in Petrograd, Russia, between 16–20 July [O.S. 3–7 July] 1917. ... The following day, July 4 (July 17), around 20,000 armed sailors from the Kronstadt naval base arrived in Petrograd. ... On 12 July, Kerensky reinstated the death penalty for rebelling, deserting, and disorderly soldiers on the Eastern Front

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Days（示威规模栏）
sources.quote: Strength 500,000 demonstrators, 4,000–5,000 Red Guard soldiers, few hundred anarchist sailors, and 12,000 soldiers

fact: 1917年8月28日至31日（儒略历；公历9月10日至13日）发生科尔尼洛夫事件：总司令科尔尼洛夫以恢复秩序为名派第三骑兵军向彼得格勒推进，克伦斯基宣布其叛国并求助苏维埃；铁路工人阻挠军列、宣传人员进入部队劝其离散，兵变未抵城下即瓦解，科尔尼洛夫被撤职关押。此役中克伦斯基向赤卫队发枪，布尔什维克影响力随即回升。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Kornilov affair
sources.quote: The Kornilov affair, was a misunderstanding by the commander in chief of the Russian Army, General Lavr Kornilov, from 10 to 13 September 1917 (Old Style 28–31 August), against the Russian Provisional Government headed by Alexander Kerensky ... by 13 September 1917 (O.S. 30 August) Kornilov's army had lost a large number of soldiers, and with no further support for Kornilov's movement, the affair had come to a bloodless end.

fact: 1917年9月1日（儒略历；公历9月14日），克伦斯基以部长会议主席身份、扎鲁德内以司法部长身份签署法令，宣布俄国为共和国。此前皇位继承问题自二月革命后一直悬置，至此由法令正式终止君主制的法律地位。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Russian Provisional Government
sources.quote: This was finally clarified on 1 September 14 September, N.S., when the Russian Republic was proclaimed, in a decree signed by Kerensky as Minister-President and Zarudny as Minister of Justice.

fact: 1917年10月24日至25日（儒略历；公历11月6日至7日）布尔什维克在彼得格勒发动武装起义，赤卫队与倒向革命的卫戍部队占领电话局、车站与政府机关；25日夜至26日凌晨（公历11月7日夜至8日）攻占冬宫，临时政府部长被捕并押入彼得保罗要塞。全俄苏维埃第二次代表大会随即通过《和平法令》与《土地法令》，后者追认农民在此前自行夺取并分配地主土地的行为。

sources.title: Wikipedia, October Revolution
sources.quote: It began through an insurrection in Petrograd (now Saint Petersburg) on 7 November 1917 [O.S. 25 October]. ... In the early morning of 26 October [N.S. 8 November], they captured the Winter Palace — the seat of the Provisional government ... The cabinet quickly passed the Decree on Peace and the Decree on Land. The Decree on Land ratified the actions of the peasants who throughout Russia had taken private land and redistributed it among themselves.

fact: 1917年3月1日（儒略历；公历3月14日），彼得格勒苏维埃发布第一号命令：士兵与水兵只在命令不与苏维埃决议冲突时才服从军官与临时政府；各部队选举代表进入苏维埃，并成立委员会管理部队，武器交由委员会保管，「任何情况下不得发给军官，即使军官要求也不行」。命令还取消了对军官称「大人」的旧称，禁止军官体罚或辱骂士兵。该命令常被说成规定选举军官，但原文并无此条。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Petrograd Soviet Order No. 1
sources.quote: Order No. 1 (Russian: Prikaz nomer odin) was the first official decree of the Petrograd Soviet of Workers' and Soldiers' Deputies, issued on March 1, 1917 (March 14, New Style). ... All weapons were to be handed over to these committees 'and shall by no means be issued to the officers, not even at their demand.' ... Despite a widespread belief that Order Number 1 infamously allowed for the election of officers, thereby undermining military discipline, the order makes no such provision.

fact: 1917年3月25日（儒略历；公历4月7日），临时政府颁布《关于粮食转归国家支配》法令，实行国家粮食专营：上一年、1916年与1917年收成的全部粮食、面包与饲料均须转归国家，生产者只可保留法定的种子、家庭口粮与饲料用量；藏匿粮食一经查出按半价没收，拒绝交售者强制征用；粮食抵押与「自由买卖」的其他同类操作被禁止。

sources.title: 俄罗斯总统图书馆（Boris Yeltsin Presidential Library）, State grain monopoly introduced in Russia
sources.quote: March 25 (April 7), 1917 the Act of the Provisional Government 'On transfer of grain in the custody of the State' introduced in Russia the state grain monopoly. ... The entire amount of 'grain, bread and fodder, harvest of previous years, of the year 1916 and the future harvest of 1917', was to be transferred to the state. ... The hidden stocks of grain, found at the inspection, were alienated in favor of the state for half the price. ... Pledge of grain and other similar operations of 'free trade' were forbidden.

fact: 1917年春彼得格勒苏维埃推行严格面包配给：从事体力劳动者每日1.5俄磅（约614克），其余人每日1俄磅。到1917年夏末，彼得格勒只剩约两天的面包储备；10月每人每日配给降至不足半俄磅。10月25日（俄历）市内粮食只够一两天，10月27日全市存粮约500吨，而按不足半磅的「饥饿标准」每日需800吨。面包房前的长队成为城市生活的日常秩序，托洛茨基称「面包队给了革命最后的刺激，也立刻成了新政权的第一个威胁」。

sources.title: Leon Trotsky, The History of the Russian Revolution, ch. 12（马克思主义文库全文）
sources.quote: The sole practical measure carried through by the Petrograd Soviet in the matter of food supply was the limitation of the consumer to a strict ration: a pound and a half of bread for people engaged in physical labour, a pound for the rest. ... The bread-lines had given the last stimulus to the revolution. They also proved the first threat to the new régime.

sources.title: The History of the Civil War in the U.S.S.R., vol. 2, ch. 9（马克思主义文库全文）
sources.quote: On October 25, 1917, the stocks of grain in Petrograd were sufficient for only one or two days. ... On October 27 there were only 500 tons of grain in the capital, but the starvation ration of less than a half a pound of bread required 800 tons of grain per day.

fact: 俄国物价在1914至1916年间翻倍；1917年2月，1卢布的购买力只相当于战前约30戈比；到1917年10月只剩6至7戈比，八个月内又贬值约四分之三。按苏联官方史学的统计，1917年工人实际工资仅为1913年的57.4%，1917年5至8月物价指数从4.20升至7.25，实际工资近乎腰斩。

sources.title: 1914-1918 Online: International Encyclopedia of the First World War, War Finance (Russian Empire)
sources.quote: Prices doubled between 1914 and 1916, and by February 1917, the purchasing power of the ruble declined to about 30 kopecks in pre-war money. ... Between February and October the ruble shriveled in value from 30 pre-war kopecks to 6 or 7 kopecks.

sources.title: The History of the Civil War in the U.S.S.R., vol. 1, ch. 10（马克思主义文库全文）
sources.quote: The price index in Russia increased from 4.20 to 7.25, that is to say, almost doubled, which implied a drop in real wages by nearly 50 per cent. Average real wages in 1917 were only 57.4 per cent of real wages in 1913.

fact: 俄国流通中的纸币从1914年7月1日的16.3亿卢布增至1917年3月1日的99.5亿卢布。临时政府把国家银行的发行限额提高五倍至165亿卢布，八个月内增发约64亿卢布，接近此前两年半战争期间的总和；到1917年10月1日，流通纸币已达约172亿卢布。国家银行战前每日印钞400万至500万卢布，1915年为2000万至3000万，1917年初已达5000万。

sources.title: Wikipedia, State Bank of the Russian Empire
sources.quote: From 1 July 1914 to 1 March 1917, the outstanding amount of ruble notes in circulation increased from 1.63 billion up to 9.95 billion rubles. ... The Provisional Government increased the banknote issue limit fivefold, bringing it to 16.5 billion rubles. ... The issue of notes during that period amounted to 6.4 billion rubles.

sources.title: 中国社会科学院俄罗斯东欧中亚研究所，苏联1922—1924年的货币改革：回顾与评价
sources.quote: 1917年10月1日，流通中的纸币总量已经达到172亿卢布，发行的纸币甚至连号码都没有，泛滥成灾。

sources.title: 1914-1918 Online, War Finance (Russian Empire)
sources.quote: Before August 1914, the State Bank had printed 4-5 million rubles in notes per day. In 1915 it was 20-30 million, and by early 1917 it had reached 50 million.

fact: 1917年临时政府发行「自由公债」，发行额约37亿卢布，被视为吸收过剩货币、抑制通胀的主要手段。彼得格勒苏维埃在布尔什维克掌权前曾命令各地苏维埃组织工人与士兵认购，但收效甚微；中上层同样不愿认购，有能力者转而购买外国证券并把资产转移出境。

sources.title: 1914-1918 Online, War Finance (Russian Empire)
sources.quote: The only tactic available to control inflation was to issue the Liberty Loan ... The Petrograd Soviet, before it was in the hands of the Bolsheviks, ordered all regional soviets to force workers and soldiers to subscribe – without success. ... But cash-strapped and frustrated with the government, the middle and upper classes did not want them either. Instead, those who could started buying foreign securities and shipping assets abroad.

sources.title: Wikipedia, State Bank of the Russian Empire
sources.quote: It issued a 'Freedom Loan' for 3.7 billion rubles.

fact: 1917年12月27日（公历；俄历12月14日），全俄中央执行委员会通过《银行国有化法令》：银行业宣布为国家垄断，所有现有私人股份银行与银行机构并入国家银行，其资产与负债由国家银行接收，私人银行暂由国家银行董事会管理；法令声称保护小额存款人的利益。同日工人与赤卫队占领彼得格勒各银行与信贷机构。

sources.title: Seventeen Moments in Soviet History, Nationalization of Banks（法令英译全文）
sources.quote: Central Executive Committee, Decree on Nationalization of Banks. December 27, 1917 ... 1. The banking business is declared a state monopoly. 2. All existing private joint-stock banks and banking offices are merged in the state bank. 3. The assets and liabilities of the liquidated establishments are taken over by the state bank. ... 6. The interests of the small depositors will be safeguarded.

sources.title: 列宁全集，在全俄中央执行委员会会议上关于银行国有化问题的讲话（1917年12月14日〔27日〕）注释
sources.quote: 12月14日（27日），按照政府的命令，工人和赤卫队占领了彼得格勒所有的银行和信贷机构。当天，在全俄中央执行委员会会议上通过了《关于银行国有化的法令》和《关于检查银行钢制保险箱的法令》。

fact: 1917年3月11日（儒略历），彼得格勒厂主与彼得格勒苏维埃签订协议，在彼得格勒实行八小时工作日；厂主代表在3月16日与工商部长会谈时称该协议只是「暂时的让步」。同年11月11日（公历），苏维埃政府颁布八小时工作日的法令，把这一安排推广为全国性规定。

sources.title: The History of the Civil War in the U.S.S.R., vol. 1, ch. 2（马克思主义文库全文）
sources.quote: On March 11 the manufacturers of Petrograd signed an agreement with the Petrograd Soviet providing for the introduction of an eight-hour working day, but on March 16, at a conference with Konovalov, Minister of Commerce and Industry, Efron, a representative of the Petrograd Society of Mill Owners and Manufacturers, declared that 'the agreement arrived at in Petrograd . . . is a temporary concession.'

sources.title: Wikipedia, Soviet Decree（早期法令清单，新历日期）
sources.quote: November 11 Decree on an Eight-Hour Working Day Sovnarkom
